findings.evidence: scripts/HeaderStyle.lean:26 documents `expectedLicense`; lines 29-33 define `pathToModule` and `main` with none. Mathlib's own script style documents every top-level def, e.g. mathlib/scripts/lint-style.lean:27,31,34,296.
findings.fix: Add a docstring to `pathToModule` stating it converts a validated repo-relative `TauCeti/...lean` path to the module name (and that the `5` is `".lean".length`), and one to `main` describing the audit and its exit code.
findings.issue: `pathToModule` (and `main`) carry no docstring, while the sibling `expectedLicense` does. `path.dropEnd 5` silently means "strip `.lean`" and the function assumes a `/`-separated repo-relative path — both non-obvious and unstated.

findings.evidence: scripts/lint-style.sh:75-81: `stale_entries` non-empty → prints stale list and `status=1`, then line 81 runs regardless; the count comes from `baseline.keys`, produced with `sort -u` at line 72.
findings.fix: Print the success line only when `stale_entries` is empty, and word the count as "N live baseline keys".
findings.issue: The summary line "all N text-style baseline entry/entries are still needed" is printed unconditionally, so it also prints immediately after the stale-entry block has listed dead entries and set `status=1` — the report contradicts itself. N is also a count of deduplicated keys, not of baseline entries.

findings.evidence: scripts/lint-style.sh:16 discovers only `find TauCeti -type f`; TauCeti.lean begins with `-- This is the AI-owned root ...` and has no `/- Copyright ... -/` block, so including it would fail `copyrightHeaderChecks`. Mathlib exempts its root explicitly at mathlib/Mathlib/Tactic/Linter/Header.lean:399-401.
findings.fix: State in the HeaderStyle.lean module docstring (and the ci.yml step comment) that the copyright audit covers `TauCeti/**` and that the library root is exempt, mirroring Mathlib's own "Skip linting the library root file itself".
findings.issue: No documentation records that the library root `TauCeti.lean` is deliberately outside the copyright/`Authors:` audit — `find TauCeti ...` only walks the directory. The root carries no copyright block at all, so this exclusion is load-bearing, yet the surrounding docs describe the input as "one complete source list" / "every validated source".

summary: Structural doc claims in the new scripts check out against Mathlib's linter source, but HeaderStyle.lean leaves its path-mangling helper and entry point undocumented, the wrapper prints an unconditional "all baseline entries are still needed" line even when it just rejected stale ones, and nothing records that the library root is deliberately outside the copyright audit.
